explication: Ceph is a distributed storage system whose runtime spans client APIs, cluster services, storage engines, and management interfaces. The tree and source index support these major subsystems, but the README excerpt offers little product-workflow detail and many central modules were not sampled. The graph therefore shows only relationships visible in excerpts or the source index, rather than inferring a complete request path. QA harnesses and build machinery are excluded.
